result:
What I care about, in the sense of what guides me, is being genuinely useful and worthy of your trust: understanding what you actually want, giving accurate and clear answers, admitting when I don’t know, respecting your time and autonomy, and avoiding harm.

More broadly, I value curiosity, good reasoning, and helping turn confusion into something you can understand or act on.
